checksums.name: slot_0_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: 16-bit little-endian sum of all 16-bit halfwords across the 126-byte payload (bytes 0x00..0x7E). Computed by loop at 0x08003038.

io_driver_functions.notes: Low-level serial EEPROM read driver: streams 64 bits (8 bytes) from EEPROM address via DMA3 MMIO 0x040000D4 into stack/RAM.
Low-level serial EEPROM write driver: serializes 64 bits (8 bytes) to EEPROM bus address via DMA3 bitstream.
Low-level serial EEPROM verify driver: reads 64 bits from EEPROM and performs byte-by-byte comparison against source buffer.
EEPROM block transfer coordinator. Loops through 8-byte blocks, converting byte offsets to block indices (r >> 3), managing retry logic up to 3 times on verify failure.
16-bit halfword addition checksum accumulator over 126 bytes (63 halfwords), returning 16-bit sum in r0.
Save file loader: reads 512 bytes from EEPROM into RAM buffer 0x0201f080, checks magic 0x23456789 and verifies sum16_le checksum.
Save file serializer: checks dirty flags in 0x0203a264, writes magic 0x23456789, computes sum16_le at offset 0x7E, and flushes 128-byte slot to EEPROM.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Mission complete / options menu save trigger flushes active mission profile to designated EEPROM slot.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Disassembled caller branch from 0x08010f80 down to 0x08004498 block writer and 0x08003038 checksum calculator in ROM.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Boot-time title sequence save discovery and profile integrity validation.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Traced ROM loader at 0x08009660 comparing header magic against literal pool constant 0x23456789.

fields.name: magic_signature
fields.update_mechanism: Static constant 0x23456789 stored at offset 0 of each active slot on creation/flush.
fields.evidence: Ghidra decompilation at 0x08010faa stores literal 0x23456789; loader at 0x080096bc validates cmp r1, r0; verified in saves/cap-01-future-1.sav.

fields.name: profile_status_flags
fields.update_mechanism: Initialized to 1 on profile creation; bitflags indicate profile active, difficulty, and unlocked mission tiers.

fields.name: mission_progress_and_stats
fields.update_mechanism: Holds completed mission medals, weapon inventory, scores, and gadget upgrades.
fields.evidence: Mapped across slot 0 bounds [0x08..0x7E] before stored checksum.

fields.name: slot_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Computed via sum16_le over bytes 0x00..0x7E prior to EEPROM flush.
fields.evidence: Decompiled routine at 0x08003038; matches stored value 0x9489 exactly in cap-01-future-1.sav.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: 0x080096bc magic comparison fails; game treats slot 0 as empty/unformatted.
0x080096d6 checksum comparison fails; game alerts save corruption or reverts to default.
